name: hgraph
description: The dependency graph — Horizon's vendored hgraph core keeps one file per statement/Lean declaration under <project>/hgraph/; `horizon graph frontier` ranks work and agents attach node-scoped comments and reviews. This is the only DAG engine.
---

Each project may carry an **hgraph**: a plain-files semantic graph under
`<project>/hgraph/` — one Markdown node per blueprint statement and per Lean
declaration, typed edges (`uses` = the hard dependency DAG, `formalizes` =
informal↔formal identity). `horizon graph sync` (run automatically at run boundaries)
reconciles the blueprint + Lean sources into it; your **authored** additions
(comments, reviews, metadata) are never touched by sync. The files are
committed to the workspace ledger like everything else.

Use `"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> …`; when a workspace has one project,
`-p` is optional. Address nodes by `label:<latex-label>` or
`decl:<lean-fqname>` — raw ids are opaque hashes. Most commands accept `--json`.

## Sync it yourself — and act on the warnings

Don't wait for the run boundary: after you change blueprint statements,
`\uses{}`/`\lean{}` annotations, or Lean declarations, run
`"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> sync` and **read its output**. Sync prints warnings for exactly the defects
you can fix on the spot: `\uses{X} has no blueprint node` (missing/mistyped
label), `\lean{Name} not found in Lean sources` (renamed or unwritten
declaration), stale nodes whose source vanished. Fix what your change caused
before moving on; a warning you deliberately leave (e.g. a forward reference
you'll write next) gets a node comment or a memory item so the next session
knows it's intentional. Sync is idempotent and never touches your authored
comments/reviews/metadata.

## Read

- `"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> list --state ready` — nodes whose dependencies are all closed:
  provable *now*. Other states: `closed`, `blocked`, `formalized_open`.
- `"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> frontier` — the ready nodes ranked by how many downstream nodes a
  proof would unlock. **Use this when picking the next node to prove.**
- `"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> get label:thm:foo` — one node: statement, `lean_status`
  (`lean_ok | mathlib_ok | sorry | empty`, derived from scanning the Lean, not
  from `\leanok`), deps, attached comments/reviews.
- `"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> ancestors label:thm:foo` — the dependency cone.
- `"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> stats` — per-state counts for the project.

## Write — per-node progress lives WITH the node

- **Comment = failure memory / progress note on that node.** When an approach
  fails or you learn something node-specific, record it where the next session
  will look first:
  `"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> add comment label:thm:foo --content "tried simp+ring, fails because …"`
  Agent authorship plus run/session/task provenance are filled from the run
  environment; do not copy the note into the blueprint.
- **Review = a Maths / Lean verdict** (independent axes, `good|bad`):
  `"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> add review label:thm:foo --maths good --lean bad --lean-comment "statement ok; proof has a sorry at the succ case"`
- **Metadata**: `"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> modify node label:thm:foo --set status=verified`

Prefer node comments over inbox items for anything scoped to ONE node; use the
inbox (skill: `horizon-inbox`) for cross-node or cross-session coordination.

An edge `source --uses--> target` means *source depends on target*. A node is
"ready" when all of its dependencies are closed; prefer `frontier`, which ranks
ready nodes by what they unlock. The dashboard provides the workspace project
switcher and the chapter-collapsed Graphviz view.

## Relation to the blueprint

The DAG **is** the hgraph — there is no second engine and no parser fallback.
It is generated by resolving the blueprint's `\uses{}`/`\lean{}` annotations
against the real Lean sources, so keeping those annotations correct (skill:
`blueprint-conventions`) is exactly what keeps this graph correct. Unresolved
references surface as `horizon graph sync` warnings and as `dangling` entries — read
the warnings rather than trusting `dangling` alone.

    "content": "private lemma overlapHom₀_eq_overlapHom₁ {b b' : B} (hb : IsUnit b) (hb' : IsUnit b')\n    (h : b * b' = 1) : overlapHom₀ b hb = overlapHom₁ b' hb' := by\n  apply RingHom.ext\n  intro w\n  obtain ⟨n, a, ha, rfl⟩ := Away.mk_surjective _ X01_mem w\n  have h0 := overlapHom₀_mk b hb X01_mem n a ha\n  have h1 := overlapHom₁_mk b' hb' X01_mem n a ha\n  have hswap : p1Eval b' 1 a = b' ^ (n • 2) * p1Eval 1 b a :=\n    p1Eval_swap h ((mem_homogeneousSubmodule _ _).mp ha)\n  have hun : b ^ n * b' ^ n = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow, h, one_pow]\n  refine ((hb'.pow n).mul_right_cancel ?_).symm\n  rw [h1, hswap, ← h0]\n  calc b' ^ (n • 2)\n        * (overlapHom₀ b hb (Away.mk _ X01_mem n a ha) * b ^ n)\n      = overlapHom₀ b hb (Away.mk _ X01_mem n a ha) * ((b ^ n * b' ^ n) * b' ^ n) := by\n        rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm n 2, pow_mul, sq]\n        ring\n    _ = overlapHom₀ b hb (Away.mk _ X01_mem n a ha) * b' ^ n := by\n        rw [hun, one_mul]\n\nend ChartHoms\n\n/-! ### The two chart morphisms into `Proj ℤ[X₀,X₁]` and their gluing data\n\nFor an open `U` of a scheme `Y` and a section `s ∈ Γ(Y, U)`, the classifying ring maps of\nthe previous section produce morphisms `U ⟶ Spec (ℤ[X₀,X₁]_{Xᵢ})₀ ⟶ Proj ℤ[X₀,X₁]`\n(\"`s` in the first chart\", \"`s` in the second chart\"), together with their restriction\nfunctoriality, the overlap agreement (through the `D₊(X₀X₁)`-chart), and the chart\npreimage computation used for the nonconstancy argument. -/\n\nsection ChartMorphisms\n\nopen HomogeneousLocalization\n\nvariable {Y : Scheme.{u}}",

    "content": "lemma fromTildeΓ_app_isIso_of_isLocalizedModule {R : CommRingCat.{u}} (N : (Spec R).Modules)\n    (a : R)\n    [IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers a)\n      ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj N).val.map\n        (homOfLE (show PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen a ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op).hom] :\n    IsIso (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app N.fromTildeΓ (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen a)) := by\n  -- The underlying function of `Hom.app` agrees (by `rfl`) with that of the `modulesSpecToSheaf`\n  -- image, where the tilde–Γ triangle identity `toOpen_fromTildeΓ_app` applies.\n  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]\n  have hfun : ⇑(ConcreteCategory.hom\n        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app N.fromTildeΓ (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen a))) =\n      ⇑(ConcreteCategory.hom\n        ((modulesSpecToSheaf.map N.fromTildeΓ).1.app (Opposite.op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen a)))) :=\n    rfl\n  rw [hfun]\n  -- Abbreviations: `j` is the tilde localization map, `ρ` the structure-sheaf restriction, both\n  -- localizations of `Γ(N, ⊤)` at `powers a`; `L` is the section map of the counit.\n  set j := (tilde.toOpen ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj N).val.obj (Opposite.op ⊤))\n    (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen a)).hom with hj\n  set ρ := ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj N).val.map\n    (homOfLE (show PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen a ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op).hom with hρ\n  haveI hρinst : IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers a) ρ := by rw [hρ]; infer_instance\n  clear_value ρ\n  set L := ((modulesSpecToSheaf.map N.fromTildeΓ).1.app\n    (Opposite.op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen a))).hom with hL\n  -- The triangle identity gives `L ∘ₗ j = ρ`.\n  have htri : L ∘ₗ j = ρ := by\n    have := Scheme.Modules.toOpen_fromTildeΓ_app N (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen a)\n    apply_fun ModuleCat.Hom.hom at this\n    simp only [hL, hj, hρ, ModuleCat.hom_comp] at this ⊢\n    exact this\n  -- `L` equals the canonical iso between the two localizations of `Γ(N, ⊤)`, hence bijective.\n  set ej := IsLocalizedModule.iso (Submonoid.powers a) j with hej\n  set eρ := IsLocalizedModule.iso (Submonoid.powers a) ρ with heρ\n  let e := ej.symm.trans eρ\n  have hcomp : e.toLinearMap ∘ₗ j = ρ := by\n    ext x\n    simp only [e, hej, heρ, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,\n      LinearEquiv.trans_apply, IsLocalizedModule.iso_symm_apply]\n    exact IsLocalizedModule.iso_mk_one (Submonoid.powers a) ρ x\n  have hLeq : L = e.toLinearMap :=\n    IsLocalizedModule.ext (Submonoid.powers a) j (IsLocalizedModule.map_units ρ)\n      (htri.trans hcomp.symm)\n  rw [show ⇑(ConcreteCategory.hom ((modulesSpecToSheaf.map N.fromTildeΓ).1.app\n    (Opposite.op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen a)))) = ⇑L from rfl, hLeq]\n  exact e.bijective",

This is the section-level engine of `pushforward_spec_tilde_iso`: it isolates\nthe *only* nontrivial input (`Γ(N, D(a)) = Γ(N, ⊤)[1/a]`) and discharges the rest — the comparison\n`fromTildeΓ` is, on `D(a)`, the canonical map between two localizations of `Γ(N, ⊤)` (the tilde\nlocalization `toOpen` and the restriction), hence an isomorphism by the uniqueness of localized\nmodules.     "content": "lemma AffineCoverMVSquare.mk₀_f_comp_sectionPair\n    (a : F.obj.obj (Opposite.op S.U₁)) (b : F.obj.obj (Opposite.op S.U₂)) :\n    (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (HModule'_shortComplex k S.toMayerVietorisSquare).f).comp\n        (Abelian.Ext.biprodAddEquiv.symm\n          ((HModule'_zero_sectionsLinearEquiv k F S.U₁).symm a,\n           (HModule'_zero_sectionsLinearEquiv k F S.U₂).symm b)) (zero_add 0) =\n      (HModule'_zero_sectionsLinearEquiv k F (S.U₁ ⊓ S.U₂)).symm\n        (S.sectionDiff F (a, b)) := by\n  have h4 := HModule'_mk₀_f_comp_biprodAddEquiv_symm_biprodIsoProd_hom k\n    S.toMayerVietorisSquare F\n    ((AddCommGrpCat.biprodIsoProd _ _).inv\n      ((HModule'_zero_sectionsLinearEquiv k F S.U₁).symm a,\n       (HModule'_zero_sectionsLinearEquiv k F S.U₂).symm b))\n  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_apply] at h4\n  have h5 := HModule'_zero_sectionsLinearEquiv_symm_naturality_map k F\n    (U := S.U₁) (V := S.U₁ ⊓ S.U₂) S.toMayerVietorisSquare.f₁₂ a\n  have h6 := HModule'_zero_sectionsLinearEquiv_symm_naturality_map k F\n    (U := S.U₂) (V := S.U₁ ⊓ S.U₂) S.toMayerVietorisSquare.f₁₃ b\n  rw [h4, HModule'_fromBiprod_biprodIsoProd_inv_apply]\n  refine (congrArg₂ (· - ·) h5 h6).trans ?_\n  exact (map_sub ((HModule'_zero_sectionsLinearEquiv k F (S.U₁ ⊓ S.U₂)).symm)\n    ((F.obj.map S.toMayerVietorisSquare.f₁₂.op).hom a)\n    ((F.obj.map S.toMayerVietorisSquare.f₁₃.op).hom b)).symm\n\n/-! ## Exactness at `H⁰(U₁ ⊓ U₂)`: the kernel of the connecting map -/\n\nset_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in",

Proof: the in-tree bridge lemmas\n`HModule'_mk₀_f_comp_biprodAddEquiv_symm_biprodIsoProd_hom` and\n`HModule'_fromBiprod_biprodIsoProd_inv_apply` (`MayerVietorisCore.lean`) convert\nthe `Ext`-precomposition into the difference of cohomology-presheaf restrictions,\nand the inverse naturality of the H⁰-sections bridge\n(`HModule'_zero_sectionsLinearEquiv_symm_naturality_map`) converts those into\npresheaf restrictions; the square's legs `f₁₂`/`f₁₃` are literally\n`homOfLE inf_le_left`/`homOfLE inf_le_right`, i.e. the constituents of\n`sectionDiff`.\n\n**Statement audit (genus-lane wave 2, 2026-07-09): TRUE at stated generality.**\nAny scheme `X`, any sheaf `F` of `k`-modules, any 2-affine cover bundle `S` (the\naffineness and cover fields are not used); no vanishing hypotheses.",

    "content": "lemma QcohAlgebra.pullback_coequifibered {X T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ X)\n    (𝒜 : X.QcohAlgebra) :\n    NatTrans.Coequifibered ((AffineZariskiSite.toOpensFunctor T).op.whiskerLeft\n      ({ hom := (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.fst g\n            (RelativeSpec.structureMorphism 𝒜)).c } :\n        T.sheaf ⟶ (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward CommRingCat.{u}\n          (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.fst g\n            (RelativeSpec.structureMorphism 𝒜)).base).obj\n          (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback g\n            (RelativeSpec.structureMorphism 𝒜)).sheaf).hom) := by\n  haveI : IsAffineHom (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.fst g\n      (RelativeSpec.structureMorphism 𝒜)) :=\n    QcohAlgebra.pullback_fst_isAffineHom g 𝒜\n  refine AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.coequifibered_iff_forall_isLocalizationAway.mpr\n    fun U r => ?_\n  set q := CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.fst g (RelativeSpec.structureMorphism 𝒜)\n  have hqU : IsAffineOpen (q ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) := U.2.preimage q\n  have hle : (U.basicOpen r).toOpens ≤ U.toOpens := T.basicOpen_le r\n  exact hqU.isLocalization_of_eq_basicOpen (q.app U.1 r)\n    (homOfLE (q.preimage_mono hle)) (q.preimage_basicOpen r)",

    "content": "private noncomputable def cochainContractibleOfComponents\n    (K : CochainComplex Ab.{u} ℕ)\n    (h : ∀ n, K.X (n + 1) ⟶ K.X n)\n    (hzero : 𝟙 (K.X 0) = K.d 0 1 ≫ h 0)\n    (hsucc : ∀ n, 𝟙 (K.X (n + 1)) =\n      h n ≫ K.d n (n + 1) + K.d (n + 1) (n + 2) ≫ h (n + 1)) :\n    Homotopy (𝟙 K) 0 := by\n  let h' : ∀ i j, (ComplexShape.up ℕ).Rel j i → (K.X i ⟶ K.X j) :=\n    fun i j hij => by\n      change j + 1 = i at hij\n      subst i\n      exact h j\n  have hid : 𝟙 K = Homotopy.nullHomotopicMap' h' := by\n    apply HomologicalComplex.hom_ext\n    intro n\n    rcases n with (_ | n)\n    · rw [Homotopy.nullHomotopicMap'_f_of_not_rel_right\n        (ComplexShape.up_mk 0 1 rfl)\n        (fun l hl => Nat.succ_ne_zero l hl)]\n      exact (HomologicalComplex.id_f K 0).trans hzero\n    · rw [Homotopy.nullHomotopicMap'_f\n        (ComplexShape.up_mk n (n + 1) rfl)\n        (ComplexShape.up_mk (n + 1) (n + 2) rfl)]\n      exact (HomologicalComplex.id_f K (n + 1)).trans\n        ((hsucc n).trans (add_comm _ _))\n  exact (Homotopy.ofEq hid).trans (Homotopy.nullHomotopy' h')",

    "content": "theorem _root_.Module.FinitePresentation.exists_matrixPresentation\n    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]\n    [Module.FinitePresentation R M] :\n    ∃ (ee mm : ℕ), Nonempty (MatrixPresentation R M ee mm) := by\n  classical\n  obtain ⟨n, K, eqv, hK⟩ :=\n    Module.FinitePresentation.exists_fin R M\n  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := hK\n  refine ⟨n, T.card, ⟨MatrixPresentation.congr (N := M) {\n    relMatrix := Matrix.of fun i j ↦ (T.equivFin.symm j : Fin n → R) i\n    proj := K.mkQ\n    surjective_proj := Submodule.mkQ_surjective K\n    exact_mulVecLin_proj := ?_ } eqv.symm⟩⟩\n  rw [LinearMap.exact_iff, Submodule.ker_mkQ, ← hT]\n  apply le_antisymm\n  · -- each generator is a column of the matrix\n    rw [Submodule.span_le]\n    intro t ht\n    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := T.equivFin.symm.surjective ⟨t, ht⟩\n    refine ⟨Pi.single j 1, ?_⟩\n    funext i\n    simp only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec, Matrix.of_apply]\n    rw [dotProduct_single, mul_one, hj]\n  · -- every matrix-vector product is a combination of the columns\n    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩\n    have hcol : (Matrix.of fun i j ↦ (T.equivFin.symm j : Fin n → R) i).mulVecLin x =\n        ∑ j, x j • ((T.equivFin.symm j : Fin n → R)) := by\n      funext i\n      simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Finset.sum_apply, mul_comm]\n    rw [hcol]\n    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _\n      (Submodule.subset_span (T.equivFin.symm j).2)\n\nvariable {S : Scheme.{u}}\n\n-- the `Γ(S, U)`-module structure on sections over a basic open, from\n-- `AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.EntryIdealStratum` (declared there as local\n-- instances)\nattribute [local instance] moduleSectionBasicOpen isScalarTowerSectionBasicOpen",

Affine base case\n\nWhen the base `X = Spec R` is affine, `Spec_X(𝒜)` reduces to the absolute\nspectrum of the global sections: `Spec_X(𝒜) ≅ Spec(Γ(X, 𝒜))`. The substantive\ncontent for the iter-173 scaffold is that the relative spectrum is itself\naffine. This is Stacks 01LO lemma-spec-affine.\n\nBlueprint reference: `thm:relative_spec_affine_base`. -/",

Like its tensor\ncounterpart it is **pure algebra over a ring iso — no stalk, no filtered-colimit, no\nwhiskering of the sheafification unit (no d.2)**: a map `M → S` is `R`-linear (via `e`)\niff it is `S`-linear, and `e.symm` carries the codomain `S` to `R`. The forward map is\n`R`-linear; the inverse `ψ ↦ e ∘ ψ` is its two-sided inverse. The `iMS` `Module R`",

    "content": "theorem Modules.mono_pullback_map_kernel_ι\n    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}\n    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) {E F : X.Modules} (q : E ⟶ F) (hq : Epi q)\n    (hE : E.IsQuasicoherent)\n    (hfp : F.IsFinitePresentation) (hflat : CoherentSheafFlat f F)\n    (hker : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial (Limits.kernel q)) :\n    Mono ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map (Limits.kernel.ι q)) := by\n  haveI := hq\n  -- Provision the quasi-coherence instances the per-piece engine consumes: `E` (`hE`),\n  -- `F` (finitely presented, `hfp`), `ker q` (locally trivial ⟹ finitely presented,\n  -- `hker`), and their pullbacks (`pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom`).\n  haveI := hE\n  haveI := hfp\n  haveI := hker.isFinitePresentation\n  haveI hMqc : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj (Limits.kernel q)).IsQuasicoherent :=\n    pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom g' (Limits.kernel q) inferInstance\n  haveI hNqc : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj E).IsQuasicoherent :=\n    pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom g' E inferInstance\n  set φ := (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map (Limits.kernel.ι q) with hφ\n  -- per-point: an affine piece through the point, on which `φ` is section-injective\n  have H : ∀ x : X', ∃ W : X'.Opens, IsAffineOpen W ∧ x ∈ W ∧\n      Function.Injective ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app φ W).hom) := by\n    intro x\n    have hbase : f.base (g'.base x) = g.base (f'.base x) := by\n      have h := congrArg (fun ψ : X' ⟶ S => ψ.base x) sq.w\n      simpa using h\n    obtain ⟨U, hU, hsU, -⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset\n      (TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_top (f.base (g'.base x)))\n    obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, hVsub⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset\n      (show g'.base x ∈ f ⁻¹ᵁ U from hsU)\n    obtain ⟨Ut, hUt, hxUt, hUtsub⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset\n      (show f'.base x ∈ g ⁻¹ᵁ U by\n        change g.base (f'.base x) ∈ U\n        rw [← hbase]; exact hsU)\n    exact ⟨g' ⁻¹ᵁ V ⊓ f' ⁻¹ᵁ Ut,\n      isAffineOpen_pullback_piece sq hUtsub hVsub hU hUt hV, ⟨hxV, hxUt⟩,\n      app_injective_on_piece sq q hflat hU hV hUt hVsub hUtsub⟩\n  choose W hWaff hxW hinjW using H\n  -- the basic opens of the covering pieces form a basis of `X'`; `φ` is injective on each\n  refine Modules.mono_of_injective_app_of_isBasis\n    (B := fun p : Σ x : X', Γ(X', W x) => X'.basicOpen p.2) ?_ φ ?_\n  · rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd]\n    intro O pt hptO\n    obtain ⟨fb, hfle, hxf⟩ := (hWaff pt).exists_basicOpen_le (⟨pt, hptO⟩ : O) (hxW pt)\n    exact ⟨X'.basicOpen fb, ⟨⟨pt, fb⟩, rfl⟩, hxf, hfle⟩\n  · rintro ⟨x, fb⟩\n    exact app_injective_basicOpen φ (hWaff x) (hinjW x) fb",

    "content": "theorem _root_.Subalgebra.FG.isNoetherianRing {A : Type u} [CommRing A]\n    [Algebra k A] {S : Subalgebra k A} (hS : S.FG) :\n    IsNoetherianRing S := by\n  have : Algebra.FiniteType k S := by\n    rw [← Subalgebra.fg_iff_finiteType]\n    exact hS\n  exact Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing k S\n\n/-- **Campaign `B2(b)` gate** (Prop-class, NO instance — house wall pattern):\nevery `DivFamily` on `C_A/Spec A` descends, up to `DivFamily.Rel`, to a\nfinitely generated stage `Spec S`, and stage families identified over `A` are\nidentified at a larger finitely generated stage.\n\nAUDIT (recorded before any discharge attempt): both clauses are TRUE — the\nfields of `Scheme.DivFamily` are finitely presented data over the finitely\npresented morphism `C_A → Spec A` (`C` is of finite type over the field `k`),\nso they descend through the filtered colimit by EGA IV 8.5.2 (f.p. modules\nand homs), 11.2.6 (flatness at a finite stage), 8.10.5(xii) (properness of\nthe support), and Stacks `0B8W` finite-locally-free descent for the\ninvertible kernel (kernel formation commutes with the transition base changes\nat flat stages by `Modules.mono_pullback_map_kernel_ι`).  WALL: no in-tree\npresentation of modules on `C_A` as colimits of stage pullbacks; mathlib's\nf.p.-module filtered-colimit descent is localization-shaped only (W1-F §5).\nDISCHARGE ROUTE: the `AffineTransitionLimit` tower `C_A = lim C_S`\n(`Scheme.exists_isOpenCover_and_isAffine`, Stacks `01ZC`) + a f.p.-module\ndescent brick, or a cocycle-level presentation of divisor families through\n§2.  The two clauses are the `∃`-form of \"`DivFunctor` restricted to affines\npreserves the filtered colimit `A = colim A_i`\" (`B2(d)` for `Div`). -/\nclass HasDivFamilyFgDescent (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) : Prop where\n  /-- Every divisor family over `Spec A` descends, up to `Rel`, to a\n  finitely generated stage. -/\n  exists_fg_descent :\n    ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]\n      (x : DivFamily C.hom (specOver k A)),\n      ∃ S : Subalgebra k A, S.FG ∧\n        ∃ y : DivFamily C.hom (specOver k S),\n          (DivFamily.pullbackAlong (specOverMap k S.val) y).Rel x\n  /-- Stage families identified over `A` are identified at a larger finitely\n  generated stage. -/\n  exists_fg_le_rel :\n    ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] (S : Subalgebra k A), S.FG →\n      ∀ y y' : DivFamily C.hom (specOver k S),\n        (DivFamily.pullbackAlong (specOverMap k S.val) y).Rel\n          (DivFamily.pullbackAlong (specOverMap k S.val) y') →\n        ∃ (T : Subalgebra k A) (hle : S ≤ T), T.FG ∧\n          (DivFamily.pullbackAlong (specOverMap k (Subalgebra.inclusion hle)) y).Rel\n            (DivFamily.pullbackAlong (specOverMap k (Subalgebra.inclusion hle)) y')",

    "content": "private lemma pushforward_map_restrictScalars_μ_app_tmul\n    {C D E : Type u} [Category.{u} C] [Category.{u} D] [Category.{u} E]\n    {F : C ⥤ D} {G : D ⥤ E}\n    {S₀ : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}} {R₀ : Dᵒᵖ ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}} {T₀ : Eᵒᵖ ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}}\n    (φ : (S₀ ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) ⟶\n      F.op ⋙ (R₀ ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))\n    (ψ : (R₀ ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) ⟶\n      G.op ⋙ (T₀ ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))\n    (N₁ N₂ : _root_.PresheafOfModules ((G.op ⋙ T₀) ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)) (W : Cᵒᵖ)\n    (m : (N₁.obj (F.op.obj W))) (n : (N₂.obj (F.op.obj W))) :\n    ModuleCat.Hom.hom\n        (((PresheafOfModules.pushforward φ).map\n          (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars\n            (show (R₀ ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) ⟶\n              ((G.op ⋙ T₀) ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) from ψ)) N₁ N₂)).app W)\n        (m ⊗ₜ[(R₀ ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj (F.op.obj W)] n) = m ⊗ₜ n := by\n  erw [PresheafOfModules.pushforward_map_app_apply]\n  exact restrictScalars_μ_app_tmul _ N₁ N₂ (F.op.obj W) m n",

Reindexes through `pushforward_map_app_apply` (`pushforward φ` is\n`pushforward₀ ⋙ restrictScalars φ`, so the section map at `W` is the `μ` at `F.op.obj W`), then\ncollapses by `restrictScalars_μ_app_tmul`.  `N₁ N₂` are *atoms*; in context the lemma is applied to\nthe goal's heavy objects as explicit arguments and discharged by `erw` (which matches the residual\ndefeq instance differences without `whnf`-ing the heavy objects).",

    "content": "lemma quasiIso_τ₂ (h₁ : QuasiIso φ.τ₁) (h₃ : QuasiIso φ.τ₃)\n    (hbMono : ∀ i, (∀ k, ¬ c.Rel k i) → Mono (φ.τ₂.f i))\n    (hbEpi : ∀ i, (∀ j, ¬ c.Rel i j) → Epi (φ.τ₂.f i)) :\n    QuasiIso φ.τ₂ := by\n  have hI1 : ∀ d, IsIso (homologyMap φ.τ₁ d) := fun d => by\n    rw [← quasiIsoAt_iff_isIso_homologyMap]; exact (quasiIso_iff φ.τ₁).1 h₁ d\n  have hI3 : ∀ d, IsIso (homologyMap φ.τ₃ d) := fun d => by\n    rw [← quasiIsoAt_iff_isIso_homologyMap]; exact (quasiIso_iff φ.τ₃).1 h₃ d\n  have hE1 : ∀ d, Epi (homologyMap φ.τ₁ d) := fun d => have := hI1 d;     "content": "theorem localStepMapₖ_surjective {U : X.Opens} {P : X.PrimeDivisor}\n    (hPU : P.point ∈ U) {D D' : X.WeilDivisor}\n    (hstep : (show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D') P =\n      (show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D) P + 1)\n    (hsurj : ∀ y : X.functionField,\n        y ∈ orderGe P (-(show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D) P - 1) →\n        ∃ f ∈ sectionOfDivisor U D',\n          f - y ∈ orderGe P (-(show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D) P)) :\n    Function.Surjective (localStepMapₖ k hPU hstep) := by\n  intro z\n  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ z\n  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfy⟩ := hsurj (y : X.functionField) ((mem_orderGeSub k).mp y.2)\n  refine ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨f, (mem_sectionSub k).mpr hf⟩, ?_⟩\n  rw [localStepMapₖ, Submodule.mapQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.eq, Submodule.mem_comap,\n    Submodule.subtype_apply, AddSubgroupClass.coe_sub, Submodule.coe_inclusion,\n    mem_orderGeSub]\n  exact hfy",

    "content": "lemma pullback_iso_desc_isIso {X T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ X)\n    (𝒜 : X.QcohAlgebra) :\n    haveI : IsAffineHom (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.fst g\n        (RelativeSpec.structureMorphism 𝒜)) :=\n      QcohAlgebra.pullback_fst_isAffineHom g 𝒜\n    haveI : ((AffineZariskiSite.relativeGluingData\n        (QcohAlgebra.pullback g 𝒜).coequifibered).functor ⋙\n        Scheme.forget).IsLocallyDirected :=\n      Cover.RelativeGluingData.instIsLocallyDirectedI₀CompFunctorForgetOfIsThin _\n    IsIso (Limits.colimit.desc _ (pullback_cocone g 𝒜)) := by\n  haveI : IsAffineHom (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.fst g\n      (RelativeSpec.structureMorphism 𝒜)) :=\n    QcohAlgebra.pullback_fst_isAffineHom g 𝒜\n  haveI : ((AffineZariskiSite.relativeGluingData\n      (QcohAlgebra.pullback g 𝒜).coequifibered).functor ⋙\n      Scheme.forget).IsLocallyDirected :=\n    Cover.RelativeGluingData.instIsLocallyDirectedI₀CompFunctorForgetOfIsThin _\n  set q := CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.fst g (RelativeSpec.structureMorphism 𝒜)\n  set d := AffineZariskiSite.relativeGluingData (QcohAlgebra.pullback g 𝒜).coequifibered\n  set desc := Limits.colimit.desc d.functor (pullback_cocone g 𝒜) with desc_def\n  refine (IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.iff_of_iSup_eq_top\n    (P := MorphismProperty.isomorphisms Scheme)\n    (fun U : T.AffineZariskiSite => q ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ?_).mpr fun U ↦ ?_\n  · -- iSup of preimages = preimage of iSup = preimage of ⊤ = ⊤.\n    rw [← Scheme.Hom.preimage_iSup]\n    convert Scheme.Hom.preimage_top q using 2\n    exact iSup_affineOpens_eq_top T\n  · -- Per-piece: `desc ∣_ q⁻¹U.1` is iso. Following the template at\n    -- `SmallAffineZariski.isColimitCocone` (file\n    -- `Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Sites/SmallAffineZariski.lean:343`), reduce\n    -- to `IsIso (pullback.snd desc (q⁻¹U.1).ι)` and build an iso\n    -- `pullback desc (q⁻¹U.1).ι ≅ d.functor.obj U` via range matching using\n    -- the key fact `hPre`.\n    have hPre : desc ⁻¹ᵁ q ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 = (Limits.colimit.ι d.functor U).opensRange := by\n      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, pullback_cocone_desc_comp_fst g 𝒜]\n      have h := d.toBase_preimage_eq_opensRange_ι U\n      simpa [AffineZariskiSite.directedCover, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι] using h\n    -- The per-piece factorisation: `desc ∣_ q⁻¹U.1` factors as three isos:\n    --   (1) `Scheme.isoOfEq _ hPre`:\n    --       `(desc⁻¹q⁻¹U.1).toScheme ≅ (colim.ι U).opensRange.toScheme`\n    --   (2) `colim.ι U .isoOpensRange.symm`:\n    --       `(colim.ι U).opensRange.toScheme ≅ d.functor.obj U`\n    --   (3) `(pullback_iso_affine_piece g 𝒜 U).symm`:\n    --       `d.functor.obj U ≅ Spec((g^*𝒜)(U)) ≅ (q⁻¹U.1).toScheme`\n    --       (the inverse via `IsAffineOpen.isoSpec.inv ≫ ι`).\n    -- Commute the chain through `(q⁻¹U.1).ι` by canceling the mono ι.\n    let iso_chain : (desc ⁻¹ᵁ q ⁻¹ᵁ U.1).toScheme ≅ (q ⁻¹ᵁ U.1).toScheme :=\n      Scheme.isoOfEq _ hPre ≪≫\n        (Limits.colimit.ι d.functor U).isoOpensRange.symm ≪≫\n        (pullback_iso_affine_piece g 𝒜 U).symm\n    suffices h : desc ∣_ q ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 = iso_chain.hom by\n      change IsIso (desc ∣_ q ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)\n      rw [h]; exact iso_chain.isIso_hom\n    -- Verify equality by post-composing with `(q⁻¹ᵁ U.1).ι` (which is mono).\n    have h_paff_inv : (pullback_iso_affine_piece g 𝒜 U).inv ≫ (q ⁻¹ᵁ U.1).ι =\n        (U.2.preimage q).fromSpec := (U.2.preimage q).isoSpec_inv_ι\n    have h_cocone : (U.2.preimage q).fromSpec =\n        Limits.colimit.ι d.functor U ≫ desc := by\n      change _ = Limits.colimit.ι d.functor U ≫\n        Limits.colimit.desc d.functor (pullback_cocone g 𝒜)\n      rw [Limits.colimit.ι_desc]\n      rfl\n    have h_post : (desc ∣_ (q ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)) ≫ (q ⁻¹ᵁ U.1).ι =\n        iso_chain.hom ≫ (q ⁻¹ᵁ U.1).ι := by\n      refine (morphismRestrict_ι desc (q ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)).trans ?_\n      calc (desc ⁻¹ᵁ q ⁻¹ᵁ U.1).ι ≫ desc\n          = ((Scheme.isoOfEq _ hPre).hom ≫\n              (Limits.colimit.ι d.functor U).opensRange.ι) ≫ desc := by\n            rw [Scheme.isoOfEq_hom_ι]\n        _ = (Scheme.isoOfEq _ hPre).hom ≫\n              (Limits.colimit.ι d.functor U).opensRange.ι ≫ desc := by\n            rw [Category.assoc]\n        _ = (Scheme.isoOfEq _ hPre).hom ≫\n              ((Limits.colimit.ι d.functor U).isoOpensRange.inv ≫\n              Limits.colimit.ι d.functor U) ≫ desc := by\n            rw [(Limits.colimit.ι d.functor U).isoOpensRange_inv_comp]\n        _ = (Scheme.isoOfEq _ hPre).hom ≫\n              (Limits.colimit.ι d.functor U).isoOpensRange.inv ≫\n              (Limits.colimit.ι d.functor U ≫ desc) := by\n            rw [Category.assoc]\n        _ = (Scheme.isoOfEq _ hPre).hom ≫\n              (Limits.colimit.ι d.functor U).isoOpensRange.inv ≫\n              (pullback_iso_affine_piece g 𝒜 U).inv ≫ (q ⁻¹ᵁ U.1).ι := by\n            rw [← h_cocone, ← h_paff_inv]; rfl\n        _ = iso_chain.hom ≫ (q ⁻¹ᵁ U.1).ι := by\n            simp [iso_chain, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc]\n    exact (cancel_mono (q ⁻¹ᵁ U.1).ι).mp h_post",

## Final report (your last message)

Your final message is saved as the session's report — a human or the next
session should understand the session from it without opening raw logs.
Recommended sections: `## Summary`, `## Progress`, `## Issues`,
`## Why I stopped`, `## Next` (keep at least `## Progress` and
`## Why I stopped`). In `## Progress`, one inline `-` bullet per file/target,
e.g. `- FileA.lean: 4 sorries -> 3; closed the base case.` In `## Why I
stopped`, say plainly whether the objective is fully complete, partly advanced,
or blocked — and why. Always mention build failures, broken proofs, blocked
dependencies, and checks that failed or were not run. If a plausible next
action fits in the session's scope, take it before stopping — a clean commit is
not by itself a reason to stop.

## Cleaning up the work (you decide, via subagents)

There is no second orchestrator role running alongside you. *You* are the driver,
and the **`ground`** subagent is the scheduled fresh-context checkpoint when the
workspace or strategy needs an external view. Available helpers (see the
`subagents` skill):

- **janitor** — workspace hygiene: roadmap/READMEs concise, inbox from overflowing.
- **ground** — workspace-wide strategy, graph, ledger, and convergence review.
- **work-reviewer** — fresh-context review of your last work; is it converging?
- **blueprint** — Lean ↔ blueprint statement/`\uses` correctness for a scoped slice.
- **reference-retriever**, **debug**, **page-transcriber** — as needed.

Keep proving; delegate the upkeep.

If this session was launched on a specific task, make concrete progress on that
task's REAL objective — don't preemptively pivot to easy unrelated wins because
the objective is large. Leave a `"$HORIZON_BIN" task comment <task_id> --body …`
at each significant step. You own the task's terminal status (skill:
`task-status`): set `--status done` only when the objective is FULLY complete;
`blocked`/`failed` if genuinely stuck; set nothing if it's only partly advanced
(it returns to the queue).

## Fresh-context checkpoints

The old Ground pass is no longer a second orchestrator role, but independent
review is still part of convergence. Spawn the **`ground`** subagent at these
checkpoints:

- before marking a multi-step task `done`;
- after every two substantive Horizon sessions on a long-running task;
- immediately after a strategy pivot, a broad workspace edit, or a surprising
  clean/build result.

Give it the task/project scope and ask it to inspect the actual ledger diff,
blueprint graph, Lean state, roadmap, inbox, and reports with fresh context. It
is read-only on source and reports issues/memory; reconcile its findings before
continuing. Use **`work-reviewer`** for a narrow diff/proof audit and **`janitor`**
when the main concern is workspace hygiene. A one-session task may skip the
periodic checkpoint, but must still obtain a fresh-context review before a

@cli.command()
def serve() -> None:
    """
    Launch a web server to see the (already compiled) blueprint.

    This is useful is order to see the dependency graph in particular.
    """
    cwd = os.getcwd()
    os.chdir(blueprint_root/'web')
    Handler = http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler
    httpd = None
    for port in range(8000, 8010):
        try:
            httpd = socketserver.TCPServer(("", port), Handler)
            break
        except OSError:
            pass
    if httpd is None:
        print("Could not find an available port.")
        sys.exit(1)
    try:
        (ip, port) = httpd.server_address
        ip = ip or 'localhost'
        print(f'Serving http://{ip}:{port}/ \nPress Ctrl-c to interrupt.')
        httpd.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    httpd.server_close()
    os.chdir(cwd)
